en: Three Visits to the Thatched Cottage

desc.zh: 和刘备一行人出发，拜访诸葛亮。
desc.en: Set out with Liu Bei and the group to visit Zhuge Liang.

if.zh: [个人战][舌战][论战]结果 = 胜利

story.zh: 刘备听闻传说中的卧龙就在近郊，决定前往拜访，邀请卧龙出山。
story.en: Hearing that the legendary Sleeping Dragon resides in the outskirts, Liu Bei resolves to visit and invite him to emerge from seclusion.

forbidden.zh: 主角为诸葛亮，徐庶，司马徽，崔州平、刘备以外的君主时无法触发。
forbidden.en: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Zhuge Liang, Xu Shu, Sima Hui, Cui Zhouping, or any Ruler other than Liu Bei.

participate.zh: 【与刘备关系等级至少为2级】，【刘备势力占据新野】，【关羽，张飞属刘备】
participate.en: 【Relationship level with Liu Bei is at least Level 2】, 【Liu Bei's Faction occupies Xinye】, 【Guan Yu and Zhang Fei belong to Liu Bei】

defy.zh: 【使途中遇到的文士成为家将】
defy.en: 【Recruit the scholar encountered on the road as a Retainer】

conditions.zh: 刘备：NPC关系等级 >= 2 或 刘备是玩家本人
conditions.en: Liu Bei: relationship level >= 2 or Liu Bei is the player

conditions.zh: 玩家身份 != 君主 或 刘备是玩家本人
conditions.en: Player's rank != ruler or Liu Bei is the player

if.zh: [个人战][舌战][论战]结果 = 胜利
[个人战][舌战][论战]结果 = 胜利
